name: Lightface
description: The same run kept light, so the sheet reads as a ruled page rather than a pattern.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 100%; height: @calc(3 + 19 * @x / @X)%; -webkit-transform: translateY(-50%); transform: translateY(-50%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
